_comment: Central test-account data. No credentials live in code. Gmail '+' aliases all deliver to trimiotest@gmail.com and follow Trimio's users-table convention trimiotest+<role><n>@gmail.com.
_passwordPolicyNote: genericPassword must satisfy the REDESIGNED signup policy (8+ chars, upper+lower+digit+special, NO sequential digits like 123). The old 'Trimio@1234' is now rejected client-side because of the '1234' sequence.
_defaultPhoneNote: NANP-VALID, and it has to be. On 2026-09-14 utils/validators.dart usPhone() started mirroring backend/shared/auth/registrationRules.js: ^[2-9]\d{2}[2-9]\d{6}$ -- neither the area code nor the EXCHANGE may start with 0 or 1. The old 5551234567 has exchange 123, so it began failing with 'Please enter a valid US phone number' and took every positive registration test with it. 202-555-0123 uses the NANP fictional 555-01xx range and satisfies both halves of the rule.

verifiedAccount._comment: Pre-provisioned VERIFIED account used by the positive login / forgot-password / quality tests. Postgres user 41501 ('Casey Client'), active + email_verified_at set, seeded by backend/scripts/seed_login_pair.js. This USED to be user 948 / trimiotest+verified@gmail.com, which no longer exists in the database -- every positive login test then failed at 'login_button' against an account the backend had never heard of. Keep this in step with roleAccounts.client: they are the same person, and the password is bcrypt-verified server-side now, so a stale value fails rather than being ignored.

_roleAccountsNote: Per-role sign-ins for the signed-in mobile and web suites. The app routes by user_type_id (1 client, 2 professional, 3 admin, 4 support, 9 vendor), so each role needs its own seeded account. Leave an entry blank and every test that needs it SKIPS with an explanatory message instead of failing. The 'professional' account must have an APPROVED profile, otherwise the app reroutes to ProfessionalNotCreatedHomePage and the dashboard is unreachable.

client._comment: Postgres user 41501 ('Casey Client'), seeded by backend/scripts/seed_login_pair.js. Has a user_profile + address (Dallas, TX) AND a real Stripe TEST card (pm_card_visa) in client_payment_methods -- without the card the booking flow reaches 'Review & pay' and the charge is refused 402. Passwords are bcrypt now, not SHA-256.

professional._comment: Postgres user 41504 = professional_id 878 ('Pat Pro'), Class A Barber (TX), approved, on duty, 5 priced services. NOTE: its professional_stripe_accounts row is a FABRICATED 'acct_SEEDED_NOT_REAL_878', so it can be dispatched and booked but CANNOT TAKE MONEY -- resolveChargeAccount refuses a non-Stripe-issued id in every environment. Point this at a Connect-onboarded pro for the payment test.

admin._comment: ORDINARY admin, user_type_id = 3 (Postgres user 53058). Used by the admin console suite and by the professional-approval test (ADM-011): approval is an ADMIN action, so the test performs it through the console rather than writing approval_status directly. This USED to be trimiotest+admin1, which became user_type_id 4 (super_admin) on 2026-08-29 -- so every 'admin' test was silently running as the super admin and could not have caught the boundary being erased. Keep this one at type 3.

superAdmin._comment: The SUPER ADMIN seat, user_type_id = 4 (Postgres user 41505). Singular and transferable -- see super_admin_transfers and the 'Handovers' section of SuperAdminPage. Lands in the SAME web shell as an admin plus one extra sidebar destination ('Super admin'); the real difference is server-side, where requireSuperAdmin reserves /admin/invitations, legal-document publish, jurisdiction status and region enable/disable. Use it to prove those are refused (403) for the plain admin above.

clientNoMembership._comment: Postgres user 41616 ('Devon Client'), trimiotest+client3. Has NO membership_subscriptions row in any live status, which is the point: ClientMembershipTest.plansAreListed exercises the plan CHOOSER, and a client who already has a plan is shown the manage screen instead. roleAccounts.client cannot serve because 41501 now carries the seeded active membership the manage tests need. Keeps its card, so it is otherwise a normal client.

clientNoCard._comment: Postgres user 41617 ('Sasha Client'), trimiotest+client4. Deliberately has NO row in client_payment_methods, which is the whole point of it: ClientStyleMeNowTest.noCardBlocksBooking asserts the app refuses an on-demand booking when there is nothing to charge, and roleAccounts.client cannot serve because 41501 must KEEP its card or the booking and payment suites lose their charge. Fully provisioned otherwise (active, email-verified, profile + address), so it signs in and reaches the flow. Restore its card with: node backend/scripts/seed_login_pair.js

professionalNoPayouts._comment: Postgres user 41621 = professional_id 881 ('Noor Pro'), trimiotest+pro4. Its professional_stripe_accounts row has payouts_enabled = false, so ProfessionalEarningsTest.withdrawalRequiresPayoutOnboarding can prove a withdrawal is refused before Connect onboarding is finished. roleAccounts.professional (878) must keep payouts enabled. Professional 1508 also has payouts disabled but is email-unverified with no user_profile and cannot sign in. Restore with: UPDATE professional_stripe_accounts SET payouts_enabled=true WHERE professional_id=881;

vendor._comment: Postgres user 41506, user_type_id = 9 with a store_vendors row, seeded by seed_login_pair.js.

support._comment: SEEDED after all: Postgres user 54124, user_type_id 5 ('Level 0: Self-Service & Community Support'), active. Support is NOT user_type_id 4 any more -- that id was reassigned to super_admin on 2026-08-29. Support occupies 5-8 per backend middleware/requireStaff.js (STAFF_TYPE_IDS = 3,4,5,6,7,8). Verified 2026-09-21: requireStaff ADMITS it to /refund/*, adminAuth REFUSES it from /admin/* with 403 'Admin access required' -- which is the whole point of having it, because that boundary is otherwise untested.

_storeFixturesNote: Names of seeded catalogue items used by the store visibility assertions. Leave blank to skip those tests. Filled 2026-09-23: the catalogue ALREADY held these (store_products 13-18 client-visible, 19-23 is_pro_only) -- the tests were skipping only because these two strings were empty, so no seeding was needed. clientVisibleProduct must be one the signed-in professional has NOT purchased: pro 878 / user 41504 has no store_orders at all, so any of 13-18 qualifies.

storeFixtures._proReviewableProductNote: A product the PROFESSIONAL store lists and that roleAccounts.professional (878 / user 41504) has NOT purchased -- it has no store_orders row at all. onlyPurchasersCanReview used clientVisibleProduct for this, but that names a product in the CLIENT shop: the professional store lists the pro-only catalogue, so 'Argan Repair Shampoo' was never on that screen and the test timed out looking for it.
